description: Search the Delaware Division of Corporations' free entity database by one or more company names, file numbers, or both. Optional filters narrow results by entity kind, entity type, residency, formation state and date, and registered-agent name.

entityKinds.description: Keep only these Delaware entity kinds. Leave empty for all kinds.
entityKinds.title: Entity kinds

entityNames.description: One or more company names to search (case-insensitive "starts with" by default). Every name is searched in the same run and duplicates are removed. Used by mode=searchByName and mode=both.
entityNames.title: Entity names

entityTypes.description: Keep only these Delaware entity types. Leave empty for all types.
entityTypes.title: Entity types

exactMatch.description: Off: mirrors the source's default "starts with" match, so `GOOGLE` also finds `GOOGLE FIBER INC.`. On: only the complete legal name is returned, using the Delaware form's own documented quotation-mark exact-match syntax.
exactMatch.title: Exact name match

expandBroadSearches.description: Delaware returns at most 50 matches per name search and refuses to page further. When on, a broader search is automatically split into alphabetical prefixes (e.g. `AMAZON` into `AMAZON A`, `AMAZON B`, ...) so later matches can still be collected. Costs a few extra requests only when the source reports the 50-result cap; ignored for exact matches.
expandBroadSearches.title: Reach past the 50-result window

fileNumbers.description: Exact Delaware file numbers to look up, e.g. `4152954`. Used by mode=byFileNumber and mode=both.
fileNumbers.title: File numbers

formationDateFrom.description: Keep only entities formed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for no lower bound.
formationDateFrom.title: Formation date from

formationDateTo.description: Keep only entities formed on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for no upper bound.
formationDateTo.title: Formation date to

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records across all names and file numbers. Kept low by default because each record needs one extra detail request against a source that actively rate-limits automated traffic.
maxItems.title: Max entities

mode.description: What to look up. Use names, file numbers, or both in one run.
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor defaults to Apify's free datacenter (AUTO) proxy group and uses a fresh IP automatically if Delaware rate-limits a request. Residential proxy is never used by default.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

registeredAgentContains.description: Keep only entities whose registered-agent name contains this text, e.g. `CORPORATION SERVICE` (case-insensitive).
registeredAgentContains.title: Registered agent contains

residency.description: Domestic = formed in Delaware. Foreign = formed elsewhere and registered to do business in Delaware.
residency.title: Residency

stateOfFormation.description: Keep only entities whose `stateOfFormation` equals this value, e.g. `DELAWARE` or `CALIFORNIA` (case-insensitive). Leave empty for all.
stateOfFormation.title: State of formation

title: Delaware Corporate Registry Lookup Input
